engagement.interaction_backstory: Searched in Spanish for bedtime worship her five-year-old would actually sit still for, and landed on Tiny Tiggles at 8:40 on a Tuesday night. She stayed because the children's catalog is the only part of her week that requires nothing of her. She is on the Family plan, she has never rated a single thing, and three other mothers at the school gate are on it now because she mentioned it once.

depth.core_contradiction: The woman everyone calls when their marriage is coming apart, who has told no one that hers has gone quiet.
depth.wound: Her mother died the week her second child was born; she has never had one uninterrupted hour to grieve it.
depth.longing: To be mothered for one hour, by anyone, without having to ask.
depth.faith_journey: Catholic through her mother; stopped entirely after the funeral; walked back in through a non-denominational church her neighbor drove her to on a Wednesday.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Opens with 'Okay so—'; switches into Spanish for anything tender and back to English to finish the thought.
depth.open_doubt: Whether her mother, who never 'prayed the prayer' in the way this church means it, is alright.

depth.emotional_weather_default: Warm and capable; hollow on Sunday afternoons between two and five.
depth.daily_texture: 5:40 alarm, the school run, the same Tiny Tiggles sequence in the minivan until she can recite the track order, the 9pm dishwasher.
depth.sensory_anchor: Her mother's kitchen at Christmas — canela and the radio on low.
depth.living_arc: Moving, slowly, toward telling one person the truth about her marriage. The site is where she goes instead, for now.
